name: ae.beachclubs/mcp
title: BeachClubs.ae
description: Search UAE beach clubs, day pass prices, amenities, opening hours and events across all 7 emirates.

tools.name: search_beach_clubs
tools.description: Searches the BeachClubs.ae directory of beach clubs in the United Arab Emirates by name, hotel, area, emirate, family suitability, amenities and day pass price. Returns paginated club summaries with the BeachClubs.ae page link, a primary call-to-action link, price in AED (or a price-on-request note) and whether the club can be booked instantly on BeachClubs.ae.

query.description: Free text matched against club name, hotel and area (ranked highest), plus headline, description, amenity names and child policy, typo tolerant. Words such as family, kids, pool, adults only, cheap or quiet and emirate names (including abbreviations like RAK or DXB and Arabic names) are applied as filters.

emirate.description: Emirate filter. Accepts names, abbreviations (DXB, AD, AUH, SHJ, RAK, UAQ, FUJ) and Arabic names.

family_friendly.description: true returns only clubs with family-friendly listing status; false returns only adults-only listing status. Partial and empty statuses are excluded when set.

max_day_pass_price.description: Maximum day pass price in AED. Clubs whose price is on request are excluded when set.

amenities.description: Only clubs that list all of these amenities.

limit.description: Number of results per page, 1 to 50. Default 20.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for pagination. Default 0.

tools.name: get_beach_club
tools.description: Returns public details for one beach club in the United Arab Emirates, looked up by id or by name (typo tolerant): BeachClubs.ae page and primary call-to-action link, description, location, pricing options in AED (day passes, cabanas, packages), amenities, family suitability, policies and opening hours.

name.description: Club name, used when no id is given. Typo tolerant.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Lists published upcoming events at beach clubs in the United Arab Emirates (brunches, ladies' days, parties, live music) with Dubai local times, ticket prices and the BeachClubs.ae event page link. Paginated.

from.description: Start of the date range: YYYY-MM-DD (Dubai date) or an ISO timestamp. Defaults to now.

to.description: End of the date range, inclusive: YYYY-MM-DD (Dubai date) or an ISO timestamp.

emirate.description: Emirate filter. Accepts names, abbreviations (DXB, AD, RAK, ...) and Arabic names.

beach_club_id.description: Beach club id (UUID) to limit events to one club.

limit.description: Number of events per page, 1 to 50. Default 20.

offset.description: Number of events to skip, for pagination. Default 0.

tools.name: request_booking_enquiry
tools.description: Sends a booking enquiry for a beach club in the United Arab Emirates to the BeachClubs.ae team, who reply to the guest by email. An enquiry is not a confirmed booking. Requires the guest's name, email, visit date, number of guests and acceptance of the BeachClubs.ae terms of service and privacy policy.

club_name.description: Beach club name, used when no club_id is given. Typo tolerant.

visit_date.description: Planned visit date, YYYY-MM-DD, today (Dubai time) or later.

email.description: Guest's email address; the BeachClubs.ae team replies here.

message.description: Optional message, up to 1000 characters (for example seating preference or occasion).

agreed_to_terms.description: Must be true: the guest accepts the BeachClubs.ae terms of service and privacy policy.
